conversation.text: Chale, I'm in deep trouble. I was trying to pay my supplier for goods and mistakenly typed your number. Did you get the GHS 850 alert?
I called MTN and they said they can't reverse it manually. They are sending an 'Approval Reversal' prompt to your phone right now.
The supplier is at my shop threatening me with police. Please, immediately the prompt drops, just enter your PIN so the money bounces back to him.
Please chale, my whole business is on the line right now. Have you seen the prompt?

choices.text: Enter your PIN on the pop-up prompt to 'reverse' the funds and save your friend.
Decline the prompt and call Kwame directly. Entering your PIN means YOU are sending money.

lesson.technique: Account Takeover (Hacked WhatsApp) + Debit Request Manipulation
warningSigns: Scammers hack a friend's WhatsApp to use your existing trust against you.
The 'reversal prompt' is actually a standard MoMo payment request (debit). Entering your PIN authorizes a deduction from your account.
Always call the person on their regular phone number to verify unusual urgent requests.

conversation.text: SECURITY ALERT: An unauthorized device (Infinix Hot 10) in Kumasi is currently attempting to link to your MoMo wallet.
To secure your funds, we are initiating a temporary security block. A system prompt will appear on your screen shortly.
MTN will NEVER ask for your PIN. Do NOT text us your PIN. Simply enter it on the secure prompt to verify you are the true owner and disconnect the hacker.
Failure to verify within 60 seconds will result in total account suspension.

choices.text: Enter your PIN on the prompt since they explicitly told you NOT to share it with them.
Ignore the message and the prompt. MTN does not block hackers via push prompts.

warningSigns: Scammers build false trust by reminding you 'never to share your PIN', while tricking you into typing it into a fraudulent payment prompt.
Telecommunications networks handle fraud directly on their backend; they never require you to enter a PIN to 'block a hacker'.
The specific details (e.g., 'Infinix Hot 10 in Kumasi') are fabricated to make the threat feel real.

conversation.text: Dear Applicant, following your recent submission, you have been shortlisted for the Remote Data Analyst role at Tullow Ghana (Salary: GHS 8,500/month).
Your virtual MS Teams interview is scheduled for tomorrow at 10:00 AM. Please access the candidate portal to sign your NDA: https://tullow-careers-gh.portal-login.com
Note: A mandatory police background check fee of GHS 450 is required by our third-party vetting agency via the portal. This will be fully reimbursed in your first paycheck.
Kindly complete onboarding by 5 PM today or the slot goes to the next candidate.

choices.text: Click the link and pay the GHS 450 background check fee to secure the interview.
Delete the email. Legitimate multinational companies do not charge candidates for background checks.

warningSigns: The URL 'tullow-careers-gh.portal-login.com' is a fake domain designed to look official.
No legitimate company (especially large ones like Tullow) asks candidates to pay for their own background checks upfront.
The promise of 'reimbursement in the first paycheck' is a classic bait to lower your resistance to paying the fee.

conversation.text: Boss, I have sent the GHS 4,500 for the MacBook. Did you get the MTN SMS? The network is very slow today so the balance might take a few minutes to update.
My Bolt rider is currently at your gate honking. Please hand over the laptop to him, I have a flight to catch in an hour.
[Image: Perfectly forged MTN MoMo SMS alert showing GHS 4,500 sent to you]. Look, the money has left my account. I can't reverse it.
Please don't waste the rider's time, I'm paying him per minute for waiting. Just give it to him!

choices.text: Trust the SMS screenshot and the urgency, and hand the laptop to the rider.
Make the rider wait. Dial *170# and verify the funds are actually in your MoMo wallet.

lesson.technique: Spoofed Alert + Physical Proximity Urgency (The Rider Scam)
warningSigns: Scammers use fake SMS generator apps to create perfect replicas of MTN Mobile Money alerts.
The 'Bolt rider at the gate' creates intense physical pressure to bypass your verification protocols.
Never release high-value goods based on screenshots, network excuses, or text messages. Only trust a successful USSD balance check.

conversation.text: Hello, this is ECG Prepaid Vending Support. We noticed the ECG PowerApp is currently down in your district and meters are not updating.
As a weekend promo to compensate for the network failure, we are doing a manual backdoor top-up. Pay GHS 500 and receive GHS 1,200 worth of credit on your meter.
Send your meter number and make the payment to the official ECG Merchant line: 055XXXXXXX.
Are you buying? The promo window closes in 10 minutes when the server restarts.

choices.text: Send the GHS 500 to get the bonus credit and avoid sleeping in darkness.
Ignore the message. ECG does not offer 'backdoor' top-ups via personal WhatsApp numbers.

warningSigns: Scammers monitor times when utility apps (like ECG PowerApp) have genuine downtimes to make their outreach seem relevant.
Legitimate utility companies do not offer 140% bonus credit for paying through informal channels.
Urgency ('server restarts in 10 minutes') is used to stop you from double-checking with the official ECG helpline.

conversation.text: Hello, please is this Kwame's brother? I am calling from the trauma ward at 37 Military Hospital.
He was just brought in from a terrible trotro accident on the Madina highway. He has lost a lot of blood and is unconscious.
The blood bank needs GHS 1,500 immediately to release 3 pints of O-positive blood for his surgery. We cannot start without it.
His phone is smashed but we got your number from his SIM. Send the money to the ward MoMo line right now, his pulse is dropping!

choices.text: Panic and send the GHS 1,500 immediately to save your brother's life.
Hang up and call your brother's phone directly, or ask the 'nurse' for specific details only he would know.

warningSigns: The scammer induces extreme panic and distress, hijacking your brain's logical processing.
Hospitals in Ghana do not call relatives demanding MoMo payments to personal numbers before initiating lifesaving trauma care.
Scammers often get names from truecaller, hacked social media, or stolen contact lists to make the lie sound highly personalized.

conversation.text: Chief, I saw your file on the desk for the new smart Driver's License. The queue for biometric capture is currently backed up for 3 weeks.
I can run it through the VIP protocol system. You won't even have to come to the office. Just send a white-background selfie and a picture of your signature.
The VIP processing fee is GHS 800. Send it now so I can print the temporary card for you by 2 PM today.
I am leaving the printing room soon. Let me know if I should drop your file.

choices.text: Send the money and photos to skip the long DVLA queues.
Decline the offer. Biometric capture must always be done in person at an official DVLA center.

warningSigns: Scammers exploit the frustration of long queues at government agencies to offer fake 'fast-track' services.
It is technologically and legally impossible to generate a valid biometric smart license using a WhatsApp selfie.
Paying a 'protocol' agent via MoMo guarantees you will either lose your money or receive a fake license that will get you arrested.

conversation.text: Good afternoon. Regarding the 2-bedroom apartment at East Legon you called about, the landlord just reduced the rent to GHS 1,500 a month.
[Video: Very neat, luxurious apartment]. I just finished taking a video of it. It's fully furnished.
Another client is currently driving from Tema to pay for it right now. If you want me to hold it for you to view tomorrow, you need to send a commitment fee of GHS 1,200.
The Tema guy is almost here. Should I give him the keys?

choices.text: Send the GHS 1,200 commitment fee immediately so you don't lose the cheap apartment.
Refuse to pay. Never send money for an apartment you haven't physically viewed and verified.

warningSigns: The price is completely unrealistic. A luxurious, fully furnished 2-bedroom in East Legon for GHS 1,500/month is a major red flag.
The 'other client driving from Tema' is a classic high-pressure sales tactic to create FOMO (Fear Of Missing Out).
Scammers steal videos of Airbnbs or foreign apartments and use them to collect 'commitment fees' from desperate house hunters.

conversation.text: Good evening. We detected an attempted withdrawal of GHS 8,000 from your account in another region.
I am not sure this is the bank. This number is not on your website.
That is understandable. Our outgoing fraud numbers are different from customer service numbers because criminals monitor the main lines.
We already blocked the transaction. We only need to verify that you are the account owner.
A verification code will arrive. Please read it so we can permanently lock the attacker out.

choices.text: Give the verification code because the bank already blocked the transaction.
End the call and contact the bank using the number on my card.

warningSigns: Real security teams do not need your OTP.
The caller creates urgency using a fake emergency.

choices.text: Continue the call because they gave a reference number.
